Accept Reject Skip to main content LinkedIn Jobs Clear text Clear text Sign in Join now Social Media Coordinator Perelel United States 1 week ago Over 200 applicants See who Perelel has hired for this role Apply Save Direct message the job poster from Perelel Becky K Becky K -- About Perelel Perelel is an OB/GYN-founded women's health company on a mission to deliver doctor-engineered supplements informed by up-to-the-minute clinical insights that meet the needs of womanhood. We take the burden off women to self-research by bringing a level of clinical rigor that doesn't exist elsewhere in the category. We're in the middle of an exciting brand evolution, broadening from a prenatal vitamin specialist to the leading authority in women's nutritional health. About the Role We're looking for a Social Media Coordinator to join our growing social team and help scale Perelel's organic presence across Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, and YouTube. This role lives at the intersection of content creation and creator operations. You'll be making content yourself and managing a network of external creators who show up on our organic feeds with topical, trend-forward content. You'll report directly to the Director of Social Media and work closely with our in-house Creative team, agency partners, and freelance designers. This is a hands-on, execution-heavy role with real ownership from day one. What You'll Do Content Creation (~50%) Produce social-first content across Instagram and TikTok (Reels, carousels, Stories, and TikTok-native formats) that feels platform-native, not repurposed Shoot and edit short-form video content on iPhone, including on-camera content, product demos, lifestyle footage, and behind-the-scenes moments Be comfortable and confident on camera. This role includes appearing in content as a relatable voice for the brand alongside the broader social team Develop and contribute to recurring content series and evergreen formats that build audience habit and expectation Concept and pitch new content ideas regularly, not just execute on what's handed to you Adapt brand campaigns for social with a creator-native sensibility, translating polished brand assets into thumb-stopping feed content Stay ahead of platform trends, audio trends, and cultural moments relevant to our audience (millennial and Gen-Z women, 24–35+) and bring ideas proactively Creator & UGC Operations (~20%) Source, vet, and onboard creators for Perelel's organic creator network, identifying women who authentically align with the brand across pregnancy, motherhood, women's health, perimenopause and general wellness Write and manage creative briefs that give creators enough direction to stay on-brand without killing authenticity Own the end-to-end creator workflow: outreach, contracting, briefing, content review, feedback, asset collection, and performance tracking Build and maintain a creator database organized by niche, audience, lifecycle stage, content style, and past performance QC all incoming creator content against brand guidelines, compliance requirements, and platform best practices before it goes live Manage creator relationships with warmth and professionalism. These are long-term partnerships, not one-off transactions Track creator content performance and surface insights on what's working, who's delivering, and where to double down Community & Operations (~30%) Support day-to-day community management across platforms, responding to comments and DMs in the brand voice with speed and care in partnership with our CX team Assist with content calendar management, scheduling, and publishing Pull and organize performance data to support weekly and monthly reporting Coordinate with the in-house Creative team and freelance designer on asset delivery timelines Support campaign launches, product drops, and brand activations with real-time social coverage Who You Are 1-2 years of experience in social media and content creation, ideally in DTC, wellness, beauty, or women's health You are a content creator first. Your portfolio includes Reels, TikToks, and carousels you've personally shot, edited, and published. This is the core of the role You're comfortable and natural on camera. You have experience sourcing and managing creators or UGC contributors. You know what a good brief looks like and why most brand briefs fail You're organized and operationally sharp. You can move fast without sacrificing quality. Startup pace means same-day turnarounds happen, and you're comfortable with that You're a clear, concise communicator, with creators, with internal teams, and in the content itself You have taste. You know the difference between content that looks like a brand ad and content that feels like it belongs in someone's feed. You lean toward the latter Bonus: Familiarity with the supplement, prenatal, or women's health space. Not required, but you'll ramp faster if you already understand the audience What You'll Work With Tools: Social scheduling and analytics platforms (e.g., NectarSocial), AirTable, Canva and/or Figma for light asset creation, Asana, Google Workspace for briefs and tracking, iPhone for content capture Team: Director of Social Media (your direct manager), agency partners, freelance designer, and the creator network you'll help build Cadence: This role operates on a weekly content rhythm with campaign surges around product launches and cultural moments. Expect a mix of planned content and reactive opportunities Why Perelel You'll be joining at a pivotal moment in the brand's evolution. The work you do will directly shape how Perelel shows up as it grows from a prenatal authority to a women's health leader You'll have real ownership and visibility. You'll be creating, building systems, and managing external relationships with direct impact on the brand's organic growth You'll work alongside a Director who is building this function and wants a partner in that build, not just an executor The brand is OB/GYN-founded with genuine clinical credibility, which means the content has substance behind it. paragraphs: I am writing to express my strong interest in the Social Media Coordinator position at Perelel. With a background in legal research and contract drafting, combined with hands-on experience in event coordination and community management, I believe I can make a valuable contribution to your dynamic social media team.

My most relevant experience includes coordinating 14 international events (average of 25 participants each) while managing logistics, communications, and stakeholder liaison. Additionally, my role as a legal associate involved drafting and negotiating 5-7 commercial agreements per month across four corporate clients, demonstrating strong project management and contract law skills.

Currently, I am completing Finnish supplementary law studies at the University of Lapland (OPH-recognised), which reflects my commitment to integrating international legal expertise with the Finnish system. My proficiency in both Finnish B2 (professional working proficiency) and English C1 / Fluent allows me to communicate effectively within diverse teams.

I am particularly drawn to Perelel's mission to deliver doctor-engineered supplements informed by up-to-the-minute clinical insights that meet the needs of womanhood. I admire your approach to bringing a level of clinical rigor that doesn't exist elsewhere in the category, and I would be excited to contribute my skills towards scaling Perelel's organic presence across social media platforms.
Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.
